blocks.text: Both searches are now complete, and we have started working through the results. I am opening this thread so that our updates on the clearance work for {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} stay in one place. Kelly and Mary are copied and will add to it as we go.
The screening search showed no obvious obstacle, and with your approval we ordered the full search. Its report came back late last week, and Kelly is now reviewing it entry by entry.
A clear screening result is encouraging, but it is not a conclusion. We will give you our view once Kelly's review is finished, and not before.
Two things from your side would help us finish:

items: A current description of everything you plan to sell under the name, including anything planned for later. The search was run against the description you gave us at the start, and if your plans have grown, we need to know now.
Whether the company has used the name anywhere already, even informally, and if so where and since when.

blocks.text: I have noted the end of next week on our docket for both answers. If either will take longer, a short note to me is all we need.
